HATMAGICIAN2-BLANK_PAINTING_EVENT.title: Blank Painting
[b][jitter](The cold wind howls)[/jitter][/b] This is a dilapidated cottage.

Judging by the paint splatters staining the floor, this might have once been an [red]art studio[/red].

An [sine]immaculately clean[/sine] painting frame stands upright in the center of the cottage, holding a canvas that is [sine]entirely blank[/sine].
Within this dust-covered cottage, you sense that this painting is [red]no ordinary object[/red].
Add a [gold]Blank Painting[/gold] to your [gold]deck[/gold]. Gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].

You remove the canvas.

In that single instant, the painting frame completely decays, crumbling into dust.
A few [gold]Gold[/gold] coins hidden within the frame spill out onto the floor.

Who would ever turn down [gold]Gold[/gold]?
You scoop up the coins and continue on your way.

An inexplicable sense of dread washes over you as you look at the painting.

Deciding to ignore it, you search the surrounding area instead.
To your surprise, a dust-covered [red]chest[/red] sits in the corner, from which you claim [sine]your rightful reward[/sine].
HATMAGICIAN2-DRAW_PROFESSOR_EVENT.title: Academy Professor
[b][jitter]"What is this?!"[/jitter][/b]

The moment you step through the door, the figure inside stares intently at the canvas resting in your hands.

"Traveller, hand it over to me. This is [red]something[/red] you should not be carrying."
"It is far too dangerous; I must deal with it."

The [blue]Professor[/blue] pays no more attention to you, turning instead to examine the canvas meticulously.

"At last, I have found you..." he mutters to himself.

The [blue]Professor[/blue] pays no more attention to you, turning instead to examine the canvas meticulously.

"At last, I have found you..." he mutters to himself.

"Very well... at least take these with you."

The [blue]Professor[/blue] turns away from you.
His face seems to carry a hint of pity. Who can say for sure?
HATMAGICIAN2-HOMELESS_PERSON_EVENT.title: The Gallery Vagrant
HATMAGICIAN2-HOMELESS_PERSON_EVENT.pages:
[sine]"Ah, a visitor from afar. You seem to be carrying [b][red]something quite fascinating[/red][/b]."

A person dressed in tattered rags calls out to you.
"Haha! My [red]paintings[/red] are [sine]far more noble[/sine] than any of these exhibits."

"How about a little barter?"[/sine]
Surrender [gold]Blank Painting[/gold]. Choose 1 card in your [gold]deck[/gold] to [gold]Duplicate[/gold].

[purple]The Vagrant?[/purple] turns away, seemingly painting something...

In a brief moment, he hands you a [red]perfect[/red] replica.

"Farewell, my friend."
Surrender [gold]Blank Painting[/gold] to remove [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards from your [gold]deck[/gold]. Gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].

[purple]The Vagrant?[/purple] snatches the [sine][red]precious object[/red][/sine] you handed him.
He turns around, seemingly painting something...

Before long, the [red]precious object[/red] is painted into literal ash, out of which spills a few Gold coins.

"Farewell, my friend."

[b][jitter]"Oh no!!! How dare you refuse me!!!"[/jitter][/b]
His high-pitched shriek sends waves of commotion through the gallery.

Once the chaos settles, you realize you seem to have lost [red]something[/red].
[purple]The Vagrant?[/purple] has vanished without a trace...

In his place, you find what seems to be a torn piece of [red]canvas[/red].
